These are hand-authored, minimal API-format fixtures, not captured live telemetry.
Jaeger: /api/traces wire shape (microsecond durations, processes, CHILD_OF references).
OpenSearch: pinned demo Collector opensearch exporter / Grafana datasource schema.
Prometheus: /api/v1/query_range matrix shape. Numeric values are test inputs only.
No fixture is published as a real discovery or Docker smoke result.
